# Subway Seat for Yazi

Yazi flavors with gold directories, an orange mode badge and a gold bar on the hovered file; previews use the bundled tmTheme. File and extension icons keep Yazi's own colours.

[Yazi](https://yazi-rs.github.io) · [All ports and previews](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/yazi/)

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in ~/.config/yazi/theme.toml:

```toml
[flavor]
dark  = "subway-seat"
light = "subway-seat"
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in ~/.config/yazi/theme.toml:

```toml
[flavor]
dark  = "subway-seat-tunnel"
light = "subway-seat-tunnel"
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in ~/.config/yazi/theme.toml:

```toml
[flavor]
dark  = "subway-seat-enamel"
light = "subway-seat-enamel"
```


Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py`. Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
